model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the F1 score and the leakage rate for three different methods: Teacher, Self-Training, and PST. The x-axis, labeled "漏标率," represents the leakage rate and is measured on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.585. The y-axis, labeled "F1," represents the F1 score and is measured on a linear scale ranging from 52.5 to 72.5. The Teacher method is represented by a red line with star markers, the Self-Training method by a blue line with square markers, and the PST method by a green line with circle markers. The Teacher method starts with the highest F1 score of approximately 72.5 at a leakage rate of 0 and decreases steadily to an F1 score of about 62.5 at a leakage rate of 0.585. The Self-Training method begins with an F1 score of around 70 at a leakage rate of 0 and also decreases steadily, ending with an F1 score of approximately 55 at a leakage rate of 0.585. The PST method starts with an F1 score of about 70 at a leakage rate of 0 and shows a more gradual decline, ending with an F1 score of around 62.5 at a leakage rate of 0.585.
